global_scale_note: Fundus/body teaching specimen: 1 native unit = 1.5 mm; nominal mucosal depth about 1.95 mm and block width about 3 mm. Two representative pits feed six glands. Pit/gland transverse dimensions are magnified 5×; eight enlarged axial rows and four sectors are teaching samples, not literal cell counts or density. Vessel wall and lumen diameters are magnified 2×. External muscle layers are a partial wall crop, so whole-wall layer proportions are schematic. The specimen cut and selectively hidden host tissues reveal structures; they do not represent natural holes. Camera zoom does not change geometry scale. Design candidate awaiting native and visual review.

sequences.title: Acid, parietal and ECL cooperation
sequences.mechanism: Separate basal endocrine/paracrine regulation from apical epithelial acid output.

states.caption: Antral G cells lie outside this fundus/body block. Circulating gastrin provides a basal input to the represented ECL population.
states.display_limit: Lamina propria is hidden for access; the uncovered space is tissue context. G cells and capillary delivery are unmodeled. Lower-gland ECL sampling is schematic, not measured physiological distribution.

states.caption: ECL histamine reaches neighboring parietal H2 receptors through extracellular tissue. It is a local regulatory signal, separate from gastric juice.
states.display_limit: Basal ECL shape is schematic; no receptor, cell process network or extracellular concentration field is resolved.

states.caption: Basal stimulation promotes apical acid secretion. H+/K+-ATPase exchanges hydrogen for potassium; chloride contributes to HCl. Gland lumen and pit carry luminal products outward.
states.display_limit: Canaliculi, channels and stimulated membrane recycling are explanatory context. No secretion rate or basal leak is simulated.

states.caption: Parietal cells also release intrinsic factor. Its vitamin B12 role is completed in the terminal ileum, outside this gastric block.
states.display_limit: Intrinsic factor is distinct from HCl and surface protection; this state does not depict stomach vitamin uptake.

schematic_limitations: No secretion kinetics, receptor dynamics or intracellular pump/canalicular geometry.
ECL placement correction is source-ready but saved geometry and visual polarity are deferred.
Other gastric endocrine populations may occur in the region but are not represented by the ECL part.
Current ECL source samples only lower gland sectors. That authored sampling choice does not imply biological ECL confinement to the chief-rich gland bottom.
acceptance_conditions: Histamine stays basal/interstitial; acid stays apical/luminal.
Antral G cells are explicitly external, never a new selectable fundus/body mesh.
Native ECL view fails acceptance if the saved ECL contacts gland lumen.

sequences.title: Chief-cell precursor and luminal activation
sequences.mechanism: Apical precursor secretion and acidic luminal activation cooperate without a basal drainage opening.

states.caption: Chief cells are enriched deeper in oxyntic glands. Basal rough ER supports protein production; secretory pepsinogen granules face the lumen.
states.display_limit: Rough ER, granules and nuclei are histological context, not separate components in the displayed cell sample.

states.caption: Chief cells release pepsinogen apically into the narrow gland lumen. The route leads to the pit and gastric lumen, never through the blind basal dome.
states.display_limit: The shared gland/pit route is a static teaching route, without particles, granule depletion or a computed flow field.

states.caption: Acidic luminal conditions convert pepsinogen to pepsin, initiating gastric protein digestion. Precursor secretion and enzyme activation are distinct steps.
states.display_limit: Activation and proteolysis are caption context. No luminal pH threshold, reaction timing or digestion fraction is measured.

schematic_limitations: The chief-rich basal closure is a boundary, not one giant cell or a secretory outlet.
No active pepsin in lamina propria, vessels or lymphatics.
A local wall block contains no complete food bolus or intestinal absorption domain.
acceptance_conditions: Chief secretory polarity and blind base remain readable.
Pepsinogen and pepsin are distinguished; acid is not portrayed as a chief-cell product.

sequences.title: Surface mucus, bicarbonate and tissue support
sequences.mechanism: Surface protection buffers incoming acid and restricts protease access while retaining open luminal gland outlets.

states.caption: Surface mucous cells line the surface and pits. Their apical mucus supports an adherent gel; this differs from mucous neck-cell secretion.
states.display_limit: Mucus gel is unmeshed context. Normal surface cells are not drawn or described as intestinal goblet cells.

states.caption: Bicarbonate in the adherent gel neutralizes acid approaching the cells. Show only a qualitative acidic-lumen to protected-surface relationship.
states.display_limit: No gel thickness, pH number, impermeable coating or acid-diffusion field is claimed. Pit outlets remain open.

states.caption: The surface barrier restricts pepsin access. Underlying vascular support belongs to living tissue, separate from the gland route carrying gastric juice.
states.display_limit: Fine mucosal capillaries and full epithelial junction/repair biology are not modeled. Displayed artery/vein courses do not establish a complete microcirculation.

schematic_limitations: No mucus film or bicarbonate transporter mesh; no measured barrier thickness.
Neck-cell mucus is not assigned the entire surface barrier function.
No ulcer, epithelial repair or perfusion simulation, and no permanent gel plug sealing pit drainage.
acceptance_conditions: The protected surface is clearly distinguished from acid-producing gland cells.
Protection is qualitative; no model color is a pH measurement.
Blood, lymph and gastric juice remain separate domains.

sequences.title: Muscle orientations and enteric coordination
sequences.mechanism: Orient local muscle layers and neural support without claiming whole-stomach motor propagation.

states.caption: Oblique, circular and longitudinal fascicles provide different orientations for gastric mechanical activity. This model samples the wall rather than an intact organ circumference.
states.display_limit: Direction and layer identity are static; there is no chyme mesh, contraction amplitude or deformation.

states.caption: The myenteric plexus lies between circular and longitudinal layers and supports motor regulation. Coordinated motility involves intrinsic and extrinsic control.
states.display_limit: Intermuscular connective-tissue host is hidden for access, not absent anatomically. Network is a schematic teaching sample; no identified synapses, neuron percentages or firing rates.

states.caption: Myenteric neural regulation is distinct from electrical coordination by unmeshed interstitial cells of Cajal. Submucosal support also contributes to local secretion and perfusion.
states.display_limit: Intermuscular/submucosal hosts are hidden for access. Do not relabel the yellow neural mesh as ICC or impose a three-per-minute contraction on each fascicle.

states.caption: Fundic accommodation and distal grinding/retropulsion are regional organ functions. This fundus/body crop cannot demonstrate antral emptying, a pyloric sphincter or a measured whole-stomach wave.
states.display_limit: No organ-lumen transport or ruga-flattening animation. Region-specific experimental circuit findings remain context, not the displayed network topology.

schematic_limitations: No intact stomach, antrum, pylorus, food bolus, ICC network or extrinsic vagal trunk.
No assumed gastric peristaltic reflex copied from an intestinal textbook circuit.
No pacemaker speed, synchronous three-layer contraction or emptying prediction.
acceptance_conditions: Three independently selectable muscle identities remain distinct.
Myenteric intermuscular location and submucosal support location remain understandable.
Function sequence states carry no physiological duration or mesh deformation.
